column1: # Quantum GammaWave: how the screen's own text is said.
# One entry per line, the screen's text first and what to say second, separated by a tab. This is not a
# translation and not a place for abbreviations the screen does not show: every left side below is a label
# that params.c actually puts on a card (checked against PD("...")), so the reader's rendering of a knob
# tools/gen_words.py turns this into the JSON file the fm1-reader protocol asks for, names it after a
# fingerprint of its own content and writes it under site/sr/w/; announce.c's ANN_WORDS_URL links to that
# exact file, and `gen_words.py --check` fails if the two ever stop agreeing. Numbers, dB, %, C#3 and
# friends are read by the reader's own rules and are not listed here.
